name: Fox
summary: Curled up asleep, tail folded over like a pillow.
text:
A sleeping fox, tail curled round and eyes shut. It is one of the brightest pieces in the range — the belly and the tail fill with warm points of light, and the whole room turns the colour of embers.

Hand-painted in earth orange, with the muzzle and paws picked out in a fine brush.

options.name: Power
options.help: Batteries are not included. The mains version comes with a remote: on, off, dimmer, timer and a slow pulse.

options.name: Laser engraving
options.help: A name, a date or a short phrase, burned into the wood. Leave it empty if you would rather not.
